panels.description: Percentage of live connections present in the pool along dead connections. A higher percentage is better.

targets.expr:
# Current live connections
(sum(${subsystem}_pool_live_connections) - (sum(${subsystem}_pool_dead_connections) or vector(0)))
/
(
  (sum(${subsystem}_pool_live_connections) - (sum(${subsystem}_pool_dead_connections) or vector(0)))
  +
  # Current dead connections
  ((sum(${subsystem}_pool_dead_connections) - sum(${subsystem}_pool_removed_connections) - sum(dns_pool_renew_connection{reason="marked dead"}))  or vector(0))
)

panels.title: Live connections ratio

panels.description: Ratio of pool connections used successfully to pool connections failing to be used on the first try.
panels.title: Connection first try success rate

panels.description: Number of connections obtained from the pool, whether new or re-used.
panels.title: Connection usage

targets.expr:
sum by (address) (
  ${subsystem}_pool_live_connections
)
-
on(address) group_left() (
  sum by (address) (${subsystem}_pool_dead_connections)
  or
  sum by (address) (${subsystem}_pool_live_connections) * 0  
)

panels.description: Note this can be zero most of the time if the DNS server is under-utilized
